issues.description: Duplicate db.sh: both a real file and a symlink are added under asr1/
issues.detail: The diff adds egs2/tal_zh_adult_teach/asr1/db.sh twice: once as a regular file (TAL_ZH_ADULT_TEACH=downloads) and once as a symlink to ../../TEMPLATE/asr1/db.sh. Two files cannot occupy the same path. One of these hunks is wrong. Recipes use the TEMPLATE symlink; the standalone file should be deleted and only the global db.sh edited.

issues.description: README config path is broken (conf/train/... vs conf/...)
issues.detail: README links the ASR config as ./conf/train/train_asr_branchformer_e24_amp.yaml, but the file actually lives at conf/train_asr_branchformer_e24_amp.yaml. The link 404s and the README is wrong about the very thing it documents. Match the actual path.

issues.description: download_and_untar.sh warns about missing unzip but does not exit
issues.detail: If unzip is absent, the script prints a message and keeps going, then later invokes unzip and dies with a confusing error. Either exit non-zero on the missing tool, or don't bother checking. Half-checking is worse than not checking.

issues.description: Usage block prints then falls through without exit on wrong argc
issues.detail: When $# is out of range, the script cats the usage but does not exit. Execution continues into realpath $1 with potentially no args. set -u + realpath of an unset positional will error obscurely instead of returning a clean usage failure. Add exit 1 after the usage.

issues.description: Hard-coded utterance counts couple the recipe to one snapshot of the dataset
issues.detail: data.sh aborts if wc -l doesn't match magic numbers (22467/3208/6072/29386/38924). Any benign upstream change to the public dataset breaks the recipe with a wc mismatch and no actionable path forward. Either log a warning, or document where the numbers come from so future maintainers aren't guessing.

issues.description: Unquoted command substitutions and variables under set -u
issues.detail: extract_dir=$(realpath $1) and realpath ${2:-$extract_dir} are unquoted; paths with spaces will explode. Same script uses set -euo pipefail, so this is a latent crash. Quote them: extract_dir=$(realpath "$1"); zip_dir=$(realpath "${2:-$extract_dir}").

review.summary: Standard ESPnet bootcamp recipe; mostly boilerplate copied from siblings, which is fine. Two real bugs: db.sh is added as both a file and a symlink in the same path (one will lose), and the README points the config link at conf/train/ which doesn't exist. The download script is sloppy under set -euo pipefail: it warns about missing unzip without exiting, prints usage without exiting, and uses unquoted $1. Hard-coded utterance counts will bite the next maintainer when the dataset moves. NEEDS-WORK; the fixes are small and obvious.
